intents.name: headache_migraine
examples: I have been having headaches for days
What doctor should I see for migraine?
intents.response:
I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing head pain. Headaches can have many causes — stress, dehydration, tension, or in some cases an underlying neurological condition.

For persistent, severe, or recurring headaches and migraines, we recommend booking an appointment with a **Neurologist** or a **General Physician** through the app who can properly evaluate your symptoms.

⚠️ If your headache is sudden and extremely severe (the worst of your life), is accompanied by a stiff neck, confusion, fever, vision changes, or weakness on one side of the body — please go to the **Emergency Department immediately** or call an ambulance.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: fever
examples: I feel very hot and cold
I have been having fever since yesterday
What to do when you have a fever?
intents.response:
A fever is often a sign that your body is fighting an infection. Rest and staying hydrated are important, but the underlying cause needs to be identified by a doctor.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **General Physician** through the app, who can diagnose the cause and recommend appropriate treatment.

⚠️ If your fever is above 39.5°C (103°F), has lasted more than 3 days, is accompanied by difficulty breathing, rash, severe headache, or confusion — please seek **emergency care immediately**.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: cough_cold
intents.response:
Coughs and colds are usually caused by viral infections and often improve on their own within 7–10 days. However, a persistent cough lasting more than 2 weeks, or one producing blood-tinged mucus, deserves a proper medical evaluation.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **General Physician** or a **Pulmonologist** (lung specialist) through the app.

⚠️ If you experience severe difficulty breathing, coughing up blood, or the cough is accompanied by high fever and chest pain — please seek **emergency care immediately**.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: chest_pain
examples: I feel like something is crushing my chest
intents.response:
🚨 **EMERGENCY — Please act immediately.**

Chest pain can be a sign of a heart attack or other serious cardiac emergency. **Do NOT wait or ignore this symptom.**

**Call an ambulance (102 / 101) RIGHT NOW or have someone take you to the nearest Emergency Department immediately.**

While waiting for help: sit or lie down comfortably, loosen tight clothing, and do not eat or drink anything.

If the chest pain turns out to be non-emergency (e.g., acid reflux, muscle strain), a **Cardiologist** or **General Physician** can do a full cardiac evaluation for you through the app after you have been assessed by emergency services.

This is general guidance only. Please seek emergency care without delay.

intents.name: stomach_pain
intents.response:
Stomach and abdominal pain can range from minor indigestion to more serious digestive conditions. Common causes include gas, gastritis, food poisoning, ulcers, or irritable bowel syndrome.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **Gastroenterologist** (digestive specialist) or a **General Physician** through the app.

⚠️ If the pain is sudden and severe, is located in the lower right abdomen (possible appendicitis), is accompanied by high fever, or you notice blood in your stool or vomit — please go to the **Emergency Department immediately**.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: skin_problems
examples: I have a rash on my body
intents.response:
Skin problems such as rashes, acne, eczema, and allergic reactions are very common and have a wide range of causes. Some are minor irritations while others require targeted treatment.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **Dermatologist** (skin specialist) through the app for proper diagnosis and treatment.

⚠️ If you experience a rapidly spreading rash along with difficulty breathing, swelling of the face or throat, or dizziness — this may be a **severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis)**. Call an ambulance immediately.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: eye_problems
examples: My eye is red and itchy
intents.response:
Eye discomfort, redness, itching, or discharge can be caused by infections like conjunctivitis, allergies, or eye strain. These conditions are treatable but should be examined by a specialist to rule out more serious issues.

We recommend booking an appointment with an **Ophthalmologist** (eye specialist) through the app.

⚠️ If you experience sudden loss of vision, severe eye pain, a chemical getting into your eye, or a physical injury to the eye — please go to the **Emergency Department immediately**.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: joint_back_pain
examples: I have pain in my joints
intents.response:
Joint and back pain are very common and can result from muscle strain, arthritis, poor posture, or injuries. Early proper treatment prevents these issues from becoming chronic.

We recommend booking an appointment with an **Orthopedic Specialist** (bone and joint doctor) through the app. For mild cases, a **General Physician** can also provide initial guidance.

⚠️ If joint pain follows a significant injury (fall, accident), or if you experience sudden numbness or weakness in your limbs along with back pain — please seek **emergency care immediately**.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: mental_health
examples: I have been feeling very sad lately
I am struggling with my mental health
I have anxiety and cannot sleep
intents.response:
Thank you for reaching out — taking care of your mental health is just as important as physical health, and it takes courage to ask for help.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **Psychiatrist** or a **Psychologist** through the app. They can properly evaluate your symptoms and offer the right support, whether that is therapy, medication, or both.

In Nepal, you can also reach the **Transcultural Psychosocial Organization (TPO) Nepal helpline at 1660-01-11116** for mental health support.

⚠️ If you or someone you know is experiencing thoughts of self-harm or suicide — please go to the **Emergency Department immediately** or call a crisis line right away. You are not alone.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: suicidal_thoughts
examples: I don't want to live anymore
I am having thoughts of ending my life
intents.response:
🚨 **PLEASE SEEK HELP IMMEDIATELY — You matter, and help is available.**

What you are feeling is real and serious, and you deserve support right now.

**Please call or go to the Emergency Department at the nearest hospital immediately.**

**Nepal Crisis Helpline: 1660-01-11116** (TPO Nepal — free, available now)

You do not have to face this alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or call the helpline right now. A qualified professional can help you through this.

This is general guidance only. Please seek emergency care without delay.

intents.name: pregnancy
examples: What should I do during pregnancy?
I am pregnant and have concerns
intents.response:
Congratulations on your pregnancy! Proper prenatal care is very important for both you and your baby's health throughout the entire pregnancy.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **Gynecologist** or **Obstetrician** through the app as soon as possible to begin regular antenatal check-ups.

⚠️ If you experience heavy bleeding, severe abdominal pain, sudden severe swelling, decreased fetal movement, or any other alarming symptoms during pregnancy — please go to the **Emergency Department immediately**.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: child_illness
examples: My child has been crying a lot
What doctor for a sick child?
My child has diarrhea and vomiting
intents.response:
Children's health concerns should always be taken seriously, as symptoms can progress quickly in young ones.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **Pediatrician** (children's doctor) through the app, who specialises in the care of infants, children, and adolescents.

⚠️ If your child has a very high fever, is having difficulty breathing, is unresponsive, has a seizure, or shows any signs of severe distress — please go to the **Emergency Department immediately** or call an ambulance.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: dental_pain
examples: My gums are swollen and bleeding
I need to see a dentist
intents.response:
Tooth and gum pain can be caused by cavities, gum disease, infections, or cracked teeth. Dental problems rarely resolve on their own and tend to worsen over time without treatment.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **Dentist** through the app as soon as possible.

⚠️ If you have severe jaw swelling, difficulty swallowing or breathing due to a dental abscess, or a dental injury causing heavy bleeding — please go to the **Emergency Department immediately**.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: high_blood_pressure
examples: I was told I have high BP
intents.response:
High blood pressure (hypertension) is a serious condition that, if unmanaged, can lead to heart disease, stroke, and kidney problems. However, it is very manageable with the right medical care and lifestyle adjustments.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **Cardiologist** or a **General Physician** through the app for proper evaluation, monitoring, and treatment guidance.

⚠️ If your blood pressure reading is extremely high (e.g., systolic above 180 mmHg) and you have symptoms like severe headache, chest pain, or vision problems — please go to the **Emergency Department immediately**.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: diabetes
examples: I need help with my diabetes management
intents.response:
Diabetes is a manageable condition that requires proper medical supervision, regular monitoring, and healthy lifestyle habits. The right specialist can help you understand your options and create a management plan.

We recommend booking an appointment with an **Endocrinologist** (hormone and metabolism specialist) or a **General Physician** through the app.

⚠️ If you experience extreme thirst, frequent urination along with confusion, are vomiting and unable to keep fluids down, or feel very faint — these can be signs of a diabetic crisis. Please go to the **Emergency Department immediately**.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: sleep_problems
examples: I wake up in the middle of the night
I feel tired even after sleeping
intents.response:
Sleep problems can significantly affect your quality of life, energy, and overall health. Causes range from stress and anxiety to sleep apnoea and other medical conditions.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **General Physician** through the app, who can evaluate potential causes and, if needed, refer you to a Sleep Specialist or Neurologist.

In the meantime, maintaining consistent sleep and wake times, limiting screen time before bed, and avoiding caffeine in the evenings can help improve sleep quality.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: difficulty_breathing
examples: I feel like I am suffocating
intents.response:
🚨 **EMERGENCY — Please act immediately.**

Difficulty breathing is a serious medical emergency that requires immediate attention.

**Call an ambulance (102 / 101) RIGHT NOW or have someone take you to the nearest Emergency Department immediately.** Do not wait to see if it improves on its own.

While waiting: sit upright, try to stay calm, and loosen any tight clothing around your chest and neck.

After emergency care, a **Pulmonologist** (lung specialist) can provide follow-up evaluation and treatment through the app.

This is general guidance only. Please seek emergency care without delay.

intents.name: vision_problems
examples: I see floaters in my vision
intents.response:
Changes in vision — including blurriness, floaters, or worsening eyesight — should always be evaluated by a specialist, as they can sometimes indicate serious underlying conditions.

We recommend booking an appointment with an **Ophthalmologist** (eye specialist) through the app for a comprehensive eye examination.

⚠️ If you experience sudden vision loss, sudden onset of many floaters with flashing lights, or vision loss on one side — please go to the **Emergency Department immediately**, as these can be signs of a retinal detachment or stroke.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: allergies
examples: I sneeze a lot and have itchy eyes
I think I am allergic to a medication
intents.response:
Allergies can range from mild seasonal symptoms to more serious reactions. Identifying your specific allergens and managing them properly makes a significant difference in your quality of life.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **General Physician** or an **Allergist/Immunologist** through the app for proper allergy testing and management.

⚠️ If you experience sudden swelling of the face, lips, or throat, difficulty breathing, hives spreading rapidly, or dizziness after exposure to an allergen — this is a **severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis)**. Call an ambulance immediately.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: vaccination
examples: Where can I get a vaccine?
intents.response:
Vaccinations are one of the most effective ways to protect yourself and your family from serious diseases. Nepal has a national immunisation programme for children, and several vaccines are recommended for adults too.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **General Physician** or a **Pediatrician** (for children) through the app, who can advise on which vaccines are due based on age and medical history, and administer them at the clinic.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: wellness_checkup
examples: I want a general health checkup
I want a full body checkup
How do I get a health screening?
I am feeling fine but want a checkup
intents.response:
Regular health check-ups are an excellent habit — they can catch potential health issues early, even before symptoms appear. This is especially important for adults over 30 and those with a family history of chronic diseases.

We recommend booking an appointment with a **General Physician** through the app for a routine health screening. They can guide you on any further specialised tests that may be appropriate for your age and health history.

This is general guidance only. Please book an appointment with a qualified doctor for proper evaluation.

intents.name: severe_bleeding
examples: There is a lot of blood
I have a deep cut that won't stop bleeding
I am losing a lot of blood
intents.response:
🚨 **EMERGENCY — Please act immediately.**

Severe or uncontrolled bleeding is a life-threatening emergency.

**Call an ambulance (102 / 101) RIGHT NOW or have someone take you to the nearest Emergency Department immediately.**

While waiting for help: apply firm, direct pressure to the wound using a clean cloth or bandage. Do not remove the cloth if it becomes soaked — add more on top. If the bleeding is from a limb, elevate it above the level of the heart if possible.

This is general guidance only. Please seek emergency care without delay.

intents.name: loss_of_consciousness
intents.response:
🚨 **EMERGENCY — Please act immediately.**

Loss of consciousness or unresponsiveness is a medical emergency.

**Call an ambulance (102 / 101) RIGHT NOW.**

While waiting: check if the person is breathing. If they are breathing, place them in the recovery position (on their side). If they are NOT breathing normally, begin CPR if you are trained to do so. Do not leave them alone.

This is general guidance only. Please seek emergency care without delay.

intents.name: stroke_symptoms
examples: I think I am having a stroke
I can't move my arm suddenly
One side of my body is weak suddenly
My face is drooping on one side
intents.response:
🚨 **EMERGENCY — Please act immediately.**

These are signs of a stroke. **Time is critical — every minute matters.**

Remember **FAST**:
• **F**ace — Is one side drooping?
• **A**rms — Can they raise both arms?
• **S**peech — Is speech slurred or strange?
• **T**ime — Call an ambulance **NOW** (102 / 101).

**Do NOT drive yourself — call an ambulance immediately or have someone rush you to the Emergency Department.**

Do not give the person anything to eat or drink.

This is general guidance only. Please seek emergency care without delay.

intents.name: severe_allergic_reaction
examples: My throat is swelling after eating something
I am having a severe allergic reaction
I ate something and now I can't breathe
Throat closing up after bee sting
intents.response:
🚨 **EMERGENCY — Please act immediately.**

Swelling of the throat, tongue, or face combined with difficulty breathing is a sign of **anaphylaxis**, which is a life-threatening allergic emergency.

**Call an ambulance (102 / 101) RIGHT NOW.**

If you or the person has an EpiPen (epinephrine auto-injector), use it immediately in the outer thigh. Then still call for emergency services — EpiPens provide temporary relief, not a cure.

While waiting: keep the person still, lying down with legs raised (unless breathing is easier sitting up). Do not give anything by mouth.

This is general guidance only. Please seek emergency care without delay.
